# pi-tools planning

Use only when sequencing, coordination, or resumability materially benefits from a plan. Lazily create or update the resolved effort resident's unparsed `scratch/plan.md`; otherwise do not create one. The parent owns it and children may read it but never edit it. It has no parser, CLI, status, review, or archive lifecycle.

<!-- awf:edit shape: default; create .awf/skills/parts/planning/shape.md to override -->
## Shape

Use only these plain headings:

```markdown
# Outcome
# Settled constraints and decisions
# Work, dependencies, and ownership
# Verification
# Open blockers
# Notes
```

Keep it current enough to resume and coordinate. It records route detail, not authority: repository truth and accepted decisions win. Remove stale detail rather than preserving a second history.
